description: Street Light Control Box, Electric Power Cost & Usage Details is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Works Department. The Street Lighting Division of Public Works maintains 40,000 out of the City's 67,000 electronic streetlights, and oversees the contracting for the rest. It also takes care of 2,800 gas lights and 1,500 fire-alarm lights. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Public Works Department. Its tags are efficiency, energy, hubhacks, infrastructure, legacy portal. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
